items.q: What is project search at Legora?
items.a: A **deal room**. Upload the contracts for one matter — tens to **millions** of docs. Isolated per project. Needs interactive latency.

items.q: Why is legal research a graph, not a vector hit?
items.a: **Hierarchy** (city → federal, worldwide), **overruling**, and **exemptions**. Toward **~10 billion vectors**. Queries **fan out**. Cold jurisdictions can wait.

items.q: Why did pgvector blow up after it 'worked surprisingly well'?
items.a: **Hot and cold projects packed into the same partitions**. Postgres pulled fat partitions, **thrashed cache**. P99 search/ingest went **100 ms → 20 s**.
**Physical isolation** and **CMEK**. Their vault key. Revoke it and Legora **cannot decrypt**. Residency already forced a full ES+blob copy per US / EU / APAC.

sections.title: Write to S3, puff the rest

items.a: Writes go **direct to object storage**. No Paxos. **Slow write, adaptable read**. Fine for search. Bad for a Kylie Jenner inventory flash sale.

items.q: Why not graph ANN on object storage?
items.a: Each graph hop is another **~200 ms S3 P99**. They use a **cluster tree** — B-tree on the geometry. Roots in DRAM, leaves on SSD. **~3 round trips**.
On **blob**. EU stays hot. **500 ms** on a cold research fetch is fine. That is **memory-hierarchy puffing** — and why one cluster serves **70–200 tenants**.

items.q: Why did a 10× median drop matter more than one RAG hit?
items.a: An agent fires **20–100 queries**. Latency **compounds**. BM25 came back. The CFO is happy. They can work on product.
